top_findings.title: No MCP server — code is a plain Go library, not an MCP protocol server
top_findings.evidence: server/*.go declare package server (server.go:1, data.go:2); no package main/func main anywhere; go.mod has no MCP SDK; mcp|jsonrpc|stdio|RegisterTool|CallTool|ListTools match only comments (server.go:8,10,15; data.go:1).
top_findings.suggestion: Add a package main entrypoint registering each capability as an MCP tool over a JSON-RPC/stdio transport.
